images.title: Seed bank and Estu's question
images.purpose: Make the size of one lakh felt against a small seed bank and the 3 varieties Estu has tasted.
images.composition: One 10 by 10 grid of round dots sits centre left with generous white space; a short label on the right and one caption below.
exact_structure: A square grid of 10 rows by 10 columns of round dots, 100 dots in all, outlined #2B2B2B.
97 dots are filled teal #0072B2; exactly 3 dots in the top row (columns 1 to 3) are filled reddish purple #CC79A7.
To the right of the grid a bracket in grey #6B7280 spans the whole grid, with the label 'Seed bank: about 100 varieties'.
A reddish purple arrow points from the 3 purple dots to the label 'Estu has tasted 3'.
Below the grid, one caption line 'The country once had about 1 lakh'.
labels: The country once had about 1 lakh
rejection: grid is not 10 by 10, or the total is not 100 dots
the purple dots number other than 3
any extra number such as a count of days or years
images.takeaway: A seed bank holds about 100 varieties, and the country once had about a lakh, far more than Estu's 3.
images.description: A 10 by 10 grid of 100 dots for a seed bank with 3 dots highlighted for the varieties Estu has tasted.
images.context: Shown beside the opening text and video of the concept.
images.teaching_notes: Look at the 100 dots first, then the 3 tasted, and ask how much bigger a lakh must be.

image_decisions.why: The hook needs one simple picture of the seed bank scale and Estu's 3 tasted varieties.
